Subject: 3-year prepay proposal & SOW (initial ask)

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the usage controls. Were evaluating Redwood for a three-year deployment across our CX & analytics teams and are prepared to move quickly if we can reach terms that match our procurement expectations.

High-level ask: BrightComms will prepay $1.2M up front (covers three years of committed usage) in exchange for a firm term discount and a price cap on per-token increases. Target economics from our side: ~18% effective discount against list for the 3-year commit, with a ramp provision that allows +/-10% usage variance year-over-year. Wed also prefer annual billing options but can do a single up-front invoice if that eases contracting.

Attached: BrightComms_SOW_draft_v2.pdf with scope and initial usage estimates. Please send proposed pricing and any standard prepay terms you require (refund policy, termination, audit rights, etc.). Wed like to get an internal approval run this week.

Thanks,
Allison Park

BrightComms

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:42:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: 3-year prepay proposal & SOW (BrightComms) — candidate counter

Thanks Sean  forwarding. Ran a blended scenario in the attached workbook. Recommendation:

Proposed commercial structure (counter):
- Total committed value: $1.2M paid up front (BrightComms asks)
- Year 1 list equivalent: $520k; Year 2: $400k; Year 3: $280k (front-loaded for onboarding/initial usage)
- Discount schedule (off list): Year 1: 16% (applied to the $520k equivalency), Year 2: 14%, Year 3: 12%
- Effective blended discount: ~15.9% across 3 years (meets most of their economics while preserving margin)
- Add-ons: 2% annual price escalator after year 1 if they auto-renew; contract to include usage minimums (70% of committed seats) and no refund for consumed credits.

If marketing wants to push to ~17% blended, we need: (a) a 24-month auto-renew commitment instead of 12, or (b) removal of early termination refunds entirely (legal sign-off). Given BrightCommss SOW, I think the 15.9% blended is a reasonable starting counter and keeps Gross margin above our threshold.

Ive attached pricing_model_brightcomms.xlsx with line-item math and a second tab for sensitivity (17%/18%). If you want me to escalate to Marissa for a one-off 17% approval, say the word.

Marcus Lin
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_model_brightcomms.xlsx (contains scenarios)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: finance-approvals@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: 3-year prepay proposal & SOW (BrightComms) — finance notes

Team,

Reviewed Marcuss scenarios. Finance constraints / asks:
- Max allowable upfront discount for this deal size and segment: 16% blended. Anything above requires VP Finance approval.
- If we accept $1.2M up-front, we must require: (1) a 2% annual escalator after Year 1, or (2) a minimum usage floor at 75% of forecast, with a make-whole payment if they drop below that. This protects recognition and reduces churn risk.
- Refunds: propose no cash refunds; offer time-limited credits (12 months) for unused prepay only if they convert to a Dedicated plan and extend the term.

We need Legal to insert language for audit rights and a cap on data egress costs. If Marcus sticks to the 15.9% blended counter, that is within a workable band if they accept the escalator or usage floor.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
